description: ATAP v0.1 §9.4(2) acceptance evidence: each case is a Witness Event whose payload smuggles a person-resolvable or free-text field forbidden by ATAP §7.6 and §4. Every case MUST FAIL validation against witness-events.schema.json — every payload sets additionalProperties:false, assessors are recorded by kind, tier and nullifier only, identifiers are opaque tokens, and questions and queries are sha256 digests. Cases naming `schema` carry a `doc` checked against that schema instead (query: schemas/query.schema.json, golden-questions: schemas/golden-questions.schema.json), where the structured query artifacts admit no free text. A must_reject case that validates is a profile defect. The must_accept cases are ordinary query filter tokens the address/key heuristic must not reject.

must_reject.name: assessor_email
must_reject.reason: email address of the person assessing (ATAP §7.6)

must_reject.name: assessor_name
must_reject.reason: named natural person (ATAP §7.6)

must_reject.name: person_name_as_assessor_kind
must_reject.reason: named natural person in place of the assessor kind (ATAP §7.6)

must_reject.name: assessor_key_id
must_reject.reason: linkable assessor identifier; only the per-version nullifier is permitted (ATAP §7.6)

must_reject.name: free_text_question
must_reject.reason: free-text question that may carry user communications; only query_sha256 is permitted (ATAP §7.6, §4)

payload.question: What was the EAP-TLS failure rate for the user jane@example.com on Oct 30?

must_reject.name: email_in_field_ref
must_reject.reason: email address smuggled into an identifier field (ATAP §7.6)

must_reject.name: client_ip_in_schema_pin
must_reject.reason: end-user IP address (ATAP §7.6)

must_reject.name: ip_port_as_source_version
must_reject.reason: IP address and port in a version token (ATAP §7.6)

must_reject.name: did_key_as_source_version
must_reject.reason: key identifier in a version token (ATAP §7.6)

must_reject.name: email_as_source_id
must_reject.reason: email address in an opaque identifier (ATAP §7.6)

must_reject.name: email_in_query_filter_value
must_reject.reason: email address as a filter value; values are numbers, booleans or opaque tokens with no `@` (ATAP §7.6)

must_reject.name: email_as_query_filter_object
must_reject.reason: filter written as {"user":"jane@example.com"}; a filter is only field_ref, op, value (ATAP §7.6)

must_reject.name: free_text_query_filter
must_reject.reason: free-text filter string that may name a person; whitespace is not permitted in a filter value (ATAP §7.6, §4)

filters.value: failed logins for Jane Smith last week

must_reject.name: query_extra_key
must_reject.reason: natural-language question smuggled in as an extra key; additionalProperties:false (ATAP §7.6)

doc.question: What was the EAP-TLS failure rate for jane@example.com?

must_reject.name: ipv4_in_query_filter_value
must_reject.reason: client IPv4 address as a filter value; an IP-shaped token is rejected (ATAP §7.6)

must_reject.name: ipv6_in_query_filter_value
must_reject.reason: client IPv6 address as a filter value; an IP-shaped token is rejected (ATAP §7.6)

must_reject.name: did_key_in_query_filter_value

must_reject.name: ipv4_cidr_in_query_filter_value

must_reject.name: ipv4_host_cidr_in_query_filter_value
must_reject.reason: single-host IPv4 CIDR; a value containing a dotted quad (or ending in /NN) is rejected (ATAP §7.6)

must_reject.name: ipv6_cidr_in_query_filter_value
must_reject.reason: IPv6 prefix; a value containing `::` (or ending in /NN) is rejected (ATAP §7.6)

must_reject.name: ipv4_in_hostname_query_filter_value
must_reject.reason: IP embedded in a wildcard-DNS hostname; a value containing a dotted quad anywhere is rejected (ATAP §7.6)

must_reject.name: ipv4_range_in_query_filter_value
must_reject.reason: IPv4 range; a value containing a dotted quad is rejected (ATAP §7.6)

must_reject.name: ipv4_in_query_filter_array
must_reject.reason: client IPv4 address inside an `in` list; each array member is checked like a single value (ATAP §7.6)

must_reject.name: golden_question_text
must_reject.reason: natural-language question text in a golden entry; only machine fields are permitted (ATAP §7.6)
